description: Formal stage contract system - each stage must prove its job is done before handing off to the next
global_stop_rules: Same trade changes outcome across files
Fake perfect performance from tiny sample
Report semantics imply more than the stage actually knows

verdict_labels.PASS: Safe to hand off to next stage
verdict_labels.WARN: Usable for diagnosis, not for optimization authority

stage_0_data_ingest.name: Data Ingest / Dataset Lock
stage_0_data_ingest.purpose: Lock the exact historical data slice being used
sanity_checks: No impossible OHLC (high >= low, close between high/low)
No missing required columns (timestamp, close, pair, session, weekday)
Session dates actually fall inside requested window

WARN: Row count differs from comparable nodes by > 10x

performance_guidelines.row_count_range: Should match expected order of magnitude for session/date range
performance_guidelines.comparable_node_variance: If one node has 10x fewer rows than comparable nodes, stop

stage_0_data_ingest.handoff_condition: Stage 0 is valid only if dataset lock hash is recorded and reproducible

stage_1_raw_opportunity_map.name: Raw Opportunity Map
sanity_checks: LONG/SHORT counts not impossibly skewed (ratio between 0.3 and 3.0)
Output count reproducible from same lock

FAIL: Raw count = 0 for clearly active market node
Same context changes by > 100x without regime explanation
WARN: Raw count extreme relative to comparable nodes (> 10x variance)
LONG/SHORT ratio > 5:1 or < 1:5

performance_guidelines.raw_observations_nature: May be noisy - not optimization truth
performance_guidelines.usage: Only use for structural presence verification

stage_1_raw_opportunity_map.handoff_condition: Stage 1 only hands off if raw observations exist and are reproducible

stage_2_clustered_impulses.name: Clustered Impulses
stage_2_clustered_impulses.purpose: Collapse overlapping raw observations into distinct impulses

required_outputs.cluster_ids: Cluster IDs linked to observations in CSV

sanity_checks: Every raw observation maps to a cluster or is explicitly excluded

FAIL: Same cluster_id has inconsistent origin timestamps (DUPLICATE_CLUSTER_ORIGINS)
WARN: avg_cluster_size < 1.5 (INSUFFICIENT_CONSOLIDATION)
Avg clusters per session < 5 (might be quiet period)
Avg clusters per session > 320 (might be volatile period)

performance_guidelines.plausibility: Should be in plausible order of magnitude across comparable nodes

stage_2_clustered_impulses.handoff_condition: Stage 2 is valid only if cluster IDs are written and cluster metrics pass guardrails
pass_criteria: Cluster IDs present in output CSV

stage_3_entry_windows.name: Entry Windows
stage_3_entry_windows.purpose: Convert clusters into tradeable entry-state windows
sanity_checks: Entry windows linked to real clusters
No orphan windows (all windows have valid cluster_id)

FAIL: Windows missing entirely for otherwise healthy clusters
WARN: entry_window_count < cluster_count * 0.5 (excessive window collapse)

healthy_profile.entry_windows: Should be <= cluster_count or only modestly different

performance_guidelines.critical_metric: If entry windows explode, stage is inventing tradable opportunities

stage_3_entry_windows.handoff_condition: Stage 3 is valid only if windows are linked and counts are plausible
pass_criteria: Entry window IDs present in CSV

stage_4_labels.name: Labels / Truth Table
stage_4_labels.purpose: Assign GOOD / BAD / NOISE to pre-entry states

required_outputs.row_level_labels: Every row has action_truth or outcome_label

sanity_checks: Every labeled row maps back to valid upstream state
Label counts reconcile with CSV row count
No missing labels for included rows
Labels use consistent vocabulary (GOOD/BAD/NOISE or ENTER/HOLD/HARVEST/PANIC/DO_NOT_ENTER)

FAIL: Label file row count mismatches summary
Labels rely on stale or alternate branch logic
Future leakage detected (labels use data not available at decision time)
WARN: One class nearly absent (< 1% of total) without reason
GOOD + BAD < 10% of total (insufficient signal)

performance_guidelines.class_balance: Can vary, but not absurdly collapse
performance_guidelines.minimum_viable: Enough GOOD and BAD must exist for separability to mean anything

stage_4_labels.handoff_condition: Stage 4 is valid only if truth table is canonical and row-reconciled

stage_5_separability.name: Separability Analysis
stage_5_separability.purpose: Check whether current descriptors can separate labeled states
sanity_checks: Metrics computed from same Stage 4 truth table
All reported features actually exist in truth table

FAIL: Top features missing from source data
WARN: Strong signal count = 0 (no predictive features found)
Top feature has AUC < 0.55 (barely better than random)

performance_guidelines.interpretation: If strong features/interactions are zero, do not pretend surface is solved
performance_guidelines.decision_point: This stage determines whether descriptors are worth fitting

stage_5_separability.handoff_condition: Stage 5 passes only if separability is lineage-consistent. May conclude 'descriptor family insufficient'
pass_criteria: Lineage to Stage 4 truth table verified

stage_6_opportunity_supply.name: Opportunity Supply / Structural Supply
stage_6_opportunity_supply.purpose: Summarize opportunity supply from validated intermediate layers
sanity_checks: Stage 6 uses Stage 2 and Stage 3 outputs
No headline 'opportunity count' silently means raw observations

FAIL: Raw observations presented as tradable opportunities
Comparable contexts differ by > 100x at cluster/window layer
Physical impossibility checks trigger (see Stage 2 guardrails)
WARN: Collapse ratio outside healthy 1-5% range
Avg cluster size outside 15-60 range

performance_guidelines.nature: Stage 6 is structural truth, not optimization truth
performance_guidelines.stability: Cluster/window counts should be reasonably stable in comparable contexts
performance_guidelines.stop_condition: If not stable, Stage 6 is broken and optimization stops

stage_6_opportunity_supply.handoff_condition: Stage 6 only passes if layered supply counts exist and guardrails pass
pass_criteria: All three counts present (raw, cluster, entry_window)

stage_7_entry_selection.name: Entry Selection / Entry Surface
stage_7_entry_selection.purpose: Turn pre-entry states into actual selected trade population
sanity_checks: Selected trades come from Stage 3/4 truth path

FAIL: Selected trade count huge but expectancy near zero
Output depends on stale branch logic
Selected trade identity changes without code/data change
WARN: Trade count < 50 (might be too small for optimization)
Win rate > 95% or < 20% (extreme, verify not bug)
Good capture < 5% (missing most opportunities)

stage_7_entry_selection.handoff_condition: Stage 7 passes only if selected trades are real, replayable, and stable enough to justify AEE work
pass_criteria: Selected trades exist and are reproducible

stage_8_aee.name: AEE (Adaptive Exit Engine)
stage_8_aee.purpose: Improve extraction on the same selected trade population
sanity_checks: AEE uses only data available at decision time

FAIL: Decision state lacks required context variables
WARN: AEE degrades everything without failure analysis
Delta PPH < 0.1 (improvement too small to matter)
AEE changes trade count (should be same population)

performance_guidelines.requirement: AEE must materially improve or be honestly rejected
performance_guidelines.threshold: Tiny positive noise is not enough
performance_guidelines.failure_interpretation: Catastrophic degradation means logic failure, not 'just one bad run'

stage_8_aee.handoff_condition: Stage 8 passes only if AEE comparison is population-consistent and diagnosable

stage_9_combined_validation.name: Combined Validation
stage_9_combined_validation.purpose: Validate final entry + AEE stack on the node
sanity_checks: Metrics derived from canonical sources only

FAIL: Combined layer uses mixed branch outputs
Final verdict PASS with meaningless improvement
WARN: Improvement marginal (< 10% delta PPH)
Trade count too small for confidence

stage_9_combined_validation.handoff_condition: Only promoted nodes move forward to production

stage_report_requirements.test_report: What tests were run and results
stage_report_requirements.proof_report: Evidence that stage contract was satisfied

stage_summary_questions: Is the stage allowed to hand off?

one_line_summary: No stage is complete unless it passes integrity checks, sanity checks, guardrails, performance reasonableness checks, and handoff contract - this stops wasting time on garbage and reserves brain for actual optimization
